name: Kasm-Workspaces
description: Desktops, browsers and apps streamed to your browser from containers

paths.name: Opt
paths.description: Kasm itself, its database and every downloaded workspace image (Docker inside the container). Plan for 30 GB or more. Keep it on a normal disk folder.

paths.name: Profiles
paths.description: Saved home folders for workspaces with a persistent profile path, like /profiles/ubuntu-jammy/{username}/.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Kasm Workspaces web interface (https), published on host as 6193

ports.name: Port 3000
ports.description: Kasm install wizard (https, first setup and upgrades), published on host as 6194

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: KASM_PORT
variables.description: The port of the Kasm web interface. It must be the same number inside and outside the container. Leave it at 6193.
